mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping faithfully preserves the entire differential diagnosis mechanism, systematically translating hypothesis generation, discriminative testing, iterative updating, and cognitive bias mitigation to ticket workflow analysis.

target_fidelity.rationale: The inference directly answers the target question by locating handoffs with the largest delay intervals and mapping them to narrowed underlying causes to prioritize matched, bounded workflow changes.

operational_coherence.rationale: The operational chain is highly intelligible. Extracting specific ticketing metrics produces a clear discriminative signal in the handoff-by-candidate matrix, firmly warranting the retention or elimination of specific delay mechanisms.

validity.rationale: All transfer criteria are fully met. The structural logic of clinical differential diagnosis is rigorously adapted to organizational delays, retaining the disciplined handling of competing hypotheses and ambiguous evidence without overstepping into unsupported causal claims.

uncertainty: Whether standard ticketing logs possess the granularity to reliably separate wait time from work time across all targeted stages.
The degree to which observational ticket data can provide independent evidence comparable to clinical test results without validated sensitivity or specificity.
